                    ### Question
                    Of the following pairs of surface molecules, what is used by the virgin T lymphocytes to extravasate to the lymph node?

                    ### Options
                    opa. CCR7 and L-selectin.
opb. VCAM and L-selectin.
opc. CCR7 and ICAM-1.
opd. CCR9 and L-selectin.
ope. CCR4 and VCAM-1.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Virgin T lymphocytes extravasate to lymph nodes primarily using CCR7 and L-selectin. CCR7 is essential for guiding T cells towards the lymph nodes by binding to the chemokine CCL21, while L-selectin facilitates the initial rolling and adhesion of T cells on high endothelial venules (HEVs) in the lymph nodes. This combination is critical for successful extravasation. Other options do not align with the known functions of these molecules in lymphocyte trafficking.
